contacts.angle: Industrial Toy Design: Reimagining the 1D Pinewood Derby as a 3D Gravity-Powered Air Derby
contacts.subject_line: Design Tip: Reimagining the 40-foot Pinewood Derby track in 3D flight with bouncing 'FOBBs'
contacts.custom_blurb: Hi Core77 editorial team, For 70 years, the Pinewood Derby has had a classic industrial-design bottleneck: a five-ounce wooden block constrained to a 1D 40-foot machined track stored in a basement once a year. In Anchorage, Alaska, we founded Gravity Wizards (https://gravitywizards.com) to redesign the physical play loop in three dimensions around 'FOBBs'—Flying Objects Built to Bounce. Built with a transparent slotted fuselage, 180-degree protractor-tuned custom fins, internal 1/2-inch steel ball-bearing Center-of-Gravity ballast, and a soft rubber bounce nosecone, FOBBs launch via a pure-gravity counterweight launcher (zero pyrotechnics or compressed gas) across gymnasiums, high-ceiling hallways, or outdoors. We pair the physical STEM airframes with a 2D-encoded 3D cube rotation trainer at https://flippingdice.twisted23.com.
